content: OWASP GenAI guidance treats prompt injection as unavoidable enough to require containment: clearly separate untrusted repository data, validate output deterministically, minimize privilege, require approval for risky actions, and never let model output drive executable operations. Sensitive disclosure, excessive agency, improper output handling, and unbounded consumption require redaction, read-only capabilities, schema validation, budgets, quotas, timeouts, and graceful advisory failure.
